programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E01
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan explore the history of the woolly mammoth and the saber-toothed cat. Thanks to modern technologies, these huge mammals are brought back to life. Researchers are looking for answers to the question of why animals perfectly adapted to extreme conditions became extinct when the ice began to melt. Michaela discovers a weakness of a prehistoric hunter that may have contributed to his extinction. Meanwhile, Steve learns about a revolutionary gene-editing technique that can revive mammoths. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E02
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. The Ice Age became an arena of struggle between Neanderthals and representatives of Homo sapiens. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan investigate how two competing species have adapted to extreme conditions. Backshall explores southern Germany, where he discovers traces of the life of early humans and their ability to deal with prehistoric predators using advanced tools and weapons. In turn, Strachan examines the differences in anatomy and skills between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. It turns out that despite the physical advantage of the former, the latter showed greater abilities in long-distance running and technological innovation. The key technology that gave them an advantage was the sewing needle, which allowed them to create tighter clothing. The decisive moment that led to the extinction of Neanderthals was global warming and environmental changes that left Homo sapiens as the dominant species. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E03
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. With the melting of ice and global warming, a completely new era in Earth's history begins. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan set out to search for the land that connected Britain with the Old Continent before the end of the Ice Age. Steve goes deep beneath the waves, and Michaela investigates the course of the natural disaster that formed the North Sea and divided Europe. The disaster was a catalyst for the further development of the first people who began to create boats. In the Arctic, Michaela works with the British Antarctic Survey drilling for ice cores. The material obtained in this way will reveal how the world's climate is changing. It turns out that global warming may create ideal conditions for the start of a new ice age. Steve will test whether people would cope if the Earth were plunged into eternal frost again. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.desc: «90 years of LaLiga (2019): Abel Resino» Abel Resino holds the unbeaten record in the history of LaLiga. As an Atlético de Madrid player, he entered the Guinness Book by keeping a clean sheet for 1,275 minutes, which goes from November 25, 1990, in which Claudio scored a goal against him in Mallorca-Atlético and March 17, 1991, on matchday 26, when Luis Enrique managed to beat him in the 45th minute of Atlético-Sporting de Gijón played in Vicente Calderon. A total of 14 consecutive games without conceding a goal in the 1990/1991 season. A mark that is still valid in professional football and that helped him win the Zamora trophy with 17 goals conceded in 33 games. Champion of the Copa del Rey, in 1995 he decided to sign for Rayo Vallecano of Madrid to play his last active season. Abel played a total of 264 games in the highest category of Spanish football

programme.title: 90 years of stories (T2019): Abel Resino

programme.desc: «90 years of LaLiga (2019): Hugo Sánchez» Hugo Sánchez Márquez shares with Leo Messi the honor of being the only two footballers alive to have won five top scorer trophies in the Championship. The same as Di Stéfano and Quini and one less than the legendary Telmo Zarra, six. He arrived from Mexico to sign for Atlético de Madrid where he scored 54 goals in 111 games and won his first Pichichi trophy. In 1985 he signed for Real Madrid, where he achieved his greatest collective and individual successes. He won five consecutive Leagues, a Copa del Rey, three Spanish Super Cups and a UEFA Cup. He also won four more trophies for the championship's top scorer. His bicycle kick goal against Logronés, his famous somersaults every time he celebrated a goal or the fact of being able to score 38 goals in a season, all with the first touch, were some of the images and feats that Hugo Sanchez left us and that will always be part of the historical memory of LaLiga

programme.title: 90 years of stories (T2019): Hugo Sánchez

programme.title: 30 for 30: Elway to Marino
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: d/f Belovezhskaya Pushcha
programme.desc: The first time you enter Belovezhskaya Pushcha as an ordinary park, the Master, the rightful owner. You breathe greedily in the resinous air until your head hurts, you break the rough tree bark, tear leaves, or even grind some small insect into dust. Just like that, out of half-childish inquisitiveness. It seems to you that all this is yours, it seems normal that man is always insatiable, and nature is always generous. But as soon as you step away from the beaten path, the first delights are replaced by slight fear: are you the master of all this thousand-year-old thicket? And you are already afraid of your loneliness, your insignificance, your weakness in front of the centuries-old pines, because a person has only the knowledge that civilization has given him, and the Pushcha has the memory of all the deeds of man. Belarus, 2010

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: The orangutans Emma and Subis have offspring from the same partner. A new chameleon also arrives at the zoo, freed from the hands of smugglers. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: A female African wild dog has died. The remaining male gets a new partner. The relationship with her is difficult. There are also marital problems for an Okapi couple. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: Because of the high legs of giraffes, there is a risk of the young being injured during births. Will Orla the giraffe give birth to her child safely? A female orangutan is also happy about having a baby. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: The penguins' enclosure needs to be beautified. Therefore, animals have to move temporarily. Now, of all times, they are suffering from malaria. The keepers are also worried about a young orangutan. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: Spider monkey Kiara has become a mother for the first time. But more than her motherly duties, she is interested in hanging out with the youngsters. Naked mole rat Janet must defend her supremacy. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: Crocodile Teju Gary is an oddball. While he ignores the ladies, he prefers to jump headfirst into a pool, even if it is empty. Giraffe Kidepo is to be moved to another zoo. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: Chester Zoo is in turmoil. While the new pregnancy of the Asian elephant Thi poses certain risks for mother and calf, the giraffe Meru doesn't put up with anything. (Station info).

programme.title: Forest as a bearer of hope – can trees save the climate
programme.desc: Natural forests are complex habitats in which animals, fungi and insects ensure balance. Ecologist Tom Crowther shows their key role in the fight against climate change and species extinction. (Station info).

programme.title: Earth – The early Earth
programme.desc: Chris Packham sheds light on a dark age: The greatest mass extinction 252 million years ago wiped out 90 percent of all species - and paved the way for the rise of the dinosaurs. (Station info).

programme.title: Earth – The early Earth
programme.desc: 800 million years ago, a tectonic shift caused global glaciation. Later, volcanic eruptions melt the ice again and give rise to new life. (Station info).

programme.title: Earth – The early Earth
programme.desc: How did Earth transform from a barren rock to a plant-covered planet? Chris Packham reports on huge mushrooms and the first swamp forests. (Station info).

programme.title: Earth – The early Earth
programme.desc: 4.6 billion years ago, Earth existed as a barren chunk of rock with no atmosphere. When the young planet was bombarded by asteroids, it ushered in a crucial new phase. (Station info).

programme.title: Earth – The early Earth
programme.desc: More than eight billion people live on earth today. They now have a greater influence on the shape of the earth's surface than many natural processes. (Station info).

programme.title: On the trail of crocodiles and hippos with Steve Backshall
programme.desc: Steve Backshall looks for giant crocodiles outside the Ndumo reserve. But a dry lake presents him with a puzzle - the animals seem to have disappeared without a trace. (Station info).

programme.title: On the trail of crocodiles and hippos with Steve Backshall
programme.desc: Can giant crocodiles still survive in the protected Ndumo Game Reserve in South Africa? And how are their counterparts doing in the wild? Steve Backshall is looking for answers. (Station info).

programme.title: Africa: jaws and claws
programme.desc: One of the oldest predators on earth lives along South Africa's coast: the shark. After 400 million years of evolution, the fascinating hunters of the sea are now threatened with extinction. (Station info).

programme.title: Chasing the rain
programme.desc: The drought is affecting all animals, including the cheetahs. When the dark clouds finally bring the hoped-for rain, a heyday begins, and not just for the predators. (Station info).

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Contest of brown bears
programme.desc: July is high season for bears in Alaska: the rivers are full to bursting with their favorite food, salmon. Using a clever technique, the bears let it land directly in their mouths. (Station info).

programme.title: Into the Blue – Indonesiens Unterwasserparadiese
programme.desc: Indonesia's spectacular underwater world: In the Blue Corner off Nusa Penida you will not only find huge corals, but also the legendary sunfish - the heaviest bony fish in the world. (Station info).

programme.title: Into the Blue – Indonesiens Unterwasserparadiese
programme.desc: Tropical forests meet warm seas in Triton Bay off New Guinea. Freshwater forms a rare ecosystem with impressive whale sharks and a rich variety of colored soft corals. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild animals' struggle for survival
programme.desc: Max Djenohan observes orangutans building nests. The zoologist is fascinated by the primate's natural abilities, which are similar to those of an engineer. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild animals' struggle for survival
programme.desc: In Rwanda, Max Djenohan stalks chimpanzees in order to befriend them. The zoologist can observe up close how the monkeys get food and how the family unit functions. (Station info).

programme.title: Big Pacific: The Violent Ocean
programme.desc: The love lives of some sea creatures couldn't be more different. While sea wolves swear eternal loyalty to their partner, sexual intercourse with giant octopuses is a deadly affair. (Station info).

programme.title: The King of the Hippos
programme.desc: It is one of the largest land mammals, the hippopotamus. The documentary follows a bull from birth. What made him king among the largest population of hippos in the Luangwa Valley? (Station info).

programme.desc: Những manh mối mới có chỉ ra bí ẩn lớn nhất về Tam giác quỷ Bermuda không? Mike Barnette, Jimmy Gadomski và nhóm điều tra lần nữa lần theo dấu vết của một vụ án bí ẩn khiến họ mất ngủ hàng đêm.

programme.title: MOUNTAIN MEN S13 EP09
programme.desc: Lauro bắt đầu cuộc đua Iditarod 1.000 dặm với đội gồm 16 chú chó của mình, đọ sức với những điều kiện khắc nghiệt và địa hình hiểm trở tại một trong những cuộc đua khắc nghiệt nhất trên trái đất. Bret và Ivy tiến vào dãy Alaska.

programme.title: FORGED IN FIRE S10 EP13
programme.desc: Hai nhà vô địch quay trở lại để có cơ hội đối đầu với một trong những người khổng lồ của chúng ta. Sau khi đối đầu với một nhà vô địch đồng hương, sẽ chỉ còn lại một thợ rèn và được giao nhiệm vụ chế tạo Kính cắt hải quân M1917.

programme.title: SWAMP PEOPLE S15 EP02
programme.desc: Đầm lầy giống như chưa từng có trước đây và các thợ săn đang chiến đấu chống trả bằng các chiến lược hoàn toàn mới. Vua đầm lầy Troy Landry cố gắng làm ca đôi mệt nhọc, chạy cả sáng và tối.

programme.title: NHỮNG THIẾT KẾ HOÀNH TRÁNG - GRAND DESIGNS

programme.desc: Vị cứu tinh của mọi người, Stone Monkey, đã mang lại hy vọng cho một cô bé tuyệt vọng mà anh hứa sẽ nhận ra. Liệu anh ta có thể thực hiện lời hứa của mình với cô gái và ngăn chặn Thần Rừng hủy diệt trái đất?

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: THANH XÀ - TIỀN DUYÊN - THE FATE OF REUNION
programme.desc: Hàng ngàn năm trước, Green Snake đã được giác ngộ dưới sự hướng dẫn của Dao Qing và dần dần yêu anh ta. Tuy nhiên, sự tận tâm của cô dành cho Dao Qing đã khiến anh tái sinh và trải qua nỗi đau của cái chết. Kể từ đó, cô bắt đầu tìm kiếm những tái sinh của Đạo Thanh trong hàng trăm năm để giúp anh đảo ngược tình thế…

programme.title: 10 ĐỐI 10 (MÙA 3) - 10 FIGHT 10 SEASON 3
programme.desc: Chương trình quy tụ các siêu sao, ca sĩ, võ sĩ, người mẫu và rapper Thái Lan vào sàn đấu quyền anh nổi tiếng. Phần 2 có trận đấu đầu tiên của nữ Thái Lan và Phần 3 có hai vận động viên giành huy chương vàng Thế vận hội cạnh tranh chức vô địch. Chương trình đấm bốc độc đáo này mang đến sự giải trí toàn diện, với các buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp, trang phục xa hoa và những trận chiến đẫm máu thực sự!

programme.title: ĐẶC VỤ VÔ HÌNH - THE GREY MEN

Sau khi ra tù, Shan giúp Tian vươn lên trong băng đảng và trở thành ông chủ mới. Tuy nhiên, ngay khi Shan trấn áp thành công băng nhóm này, anh phát hiện ra một bí mật gây sốc về Tian...
